correctness.rationale: Explicit finite Laurent projection identity for d=0,1,2, confirmed by full-support integer polynomial arithmetic, combined with exact expansion modulo nine yields A(3m+d) ≡ A(m)A(d)+3md(A(m)-3A(m-1)). Lucas modulo three and A(1)=3,A(2)=15 give 3|A(m) for all m>0, annihilating the corrective term; iteration establishes the all-index digit product. Finite census follows combinatorially. Actual checker also replays independent sums and all three Laurent identities.
